relationships.evidence: DT_World receives m_nAreaType at +0x430 and the icon selector reads that field through ClientWorldGetter
the HUD updater recreates the area sprite when the replicated area type differs from its retained last value

findings.fact: The client receives the server world area type and maps it directly to three HUD sprites.
findings.evidence: Client DT_World stores m_nAreaType at +0x430. ClientAreaIconPath maps 0 to area_icon_combat, 1 to area_icon_safearea and 2 to area_icon_elysium; the server clamps the transmitted value.
findings.consequence: The area icon is a projection of server world authority, not a client-side zone-volume test.

findings.fact: The HUD area icon is recreated when the replicated value changes.
findings.evidence: ClientAreaIconUpdate compares the world value with its retained HUD value, destroys and recreates the sprite through ClientAreaIconPath, stores the new value and drives its timing or fade state.
findings.consequence: Presentation may animate independently, but it must follow the replicated enum transition.

findings.fact: The focused quickbar Discipline dispatcher does not own the zone refusal.
findings.evidence: ClientQuickbarDisciplineDispatch resolves the selected compiled index and sends vdiscipline_int without reading client m_nAreaType; the server shared authority performs eligibility before commit.
findings.consequence: Quickbar disabling remains presentation work unless another client consumer is recovered; the server must reject forged or stale requests.
